title: ADR-0017: Unified Project Hooks
rationale: Two mechanisms for Project entry points (manifest checkables + module functions) is unjustified. One mechanism — Dagger module functions — is simpler, more expressive, and follows the everything-is-Dagger-code paradigm.

title: dagmar-624c: Go port/adapter layer removed — Project Hook Services are Dagger functions
rationale: Env.WithMainModule() registers hook functions natively as LLM tools; conformance via Dagger introspection (Module.Functions()); Tier-B abstraction = Dagger function name, not Go interface. Tracer/Span retained (observability, not a Project Hook Service). dagmar-bootstrap/dagmar-gate untouched (programmatic hooks). os-eco term replaced by Project Hook Services everywhere. Next: dagmar-2cc8 (ADR-0018 code cleanup), then dagmar-c712 (ADR-0019 hook signatures + introspection conformance, blocked by 2cc8).
